answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, converted to a slow vesting stream, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The horizon holds work receipts rather than names, so the sable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The echo of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
